text:
incident-bot: PAGE: service-routing ALERT — sudden cross-zone latency jitter + 5xx increase observed for region=eu-west2, start=~4860001200. Auto-steering engaged. Paging oncall.

sarah.k: seeing this on dashboards, 95th latency spiked from 120ms -> 780ms for eu-west2, error rate up to 1.8% (normally 0.05%). Lots of retries in frontends.

devon.p: grabbing logs, looks like there was a routing policy rollout 20m ago that changed weights for latency-tier fallback. could be oscillating between eu-west2 and eu-north1.

jamie: can we pause the latency-tier rollout? runbook step 2 covers rollback.

sarah.k: on it — disabling the steering policy for eu region now. `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/policy/steer/disable -d '{"scope":"eu*","policy":"latency-tier-fallback"}'`

ops-bot: action accepted — steering policy (latency-tier-fallback) marked DISABLED for matching scope eu*. Propagation to routers ~30s.

nate.l: traffic metrics flattening but still seeing some 5xx from edge. Could be DNS TTL overlap causing some clients to continue using stale endpoints.

emily-r: confirmed DNS TTL for service is 30s but some CDNs cached negative/old entries; also seeing AZ-specific backend 503s in eu-west2-a logs.

devon.p: posting snippets from proxy logs:
```
[4860001212] proxy eu-west2-a upstream failed: code=503 idle_conn_reset
[4860001220] route=eu-north1 weight=0.55 duration=780ms
[4860001230] route=eu-west2 weight=0.45 duration=680ms
```

jamie: that weight flip looks like the rollout controller trying to keep latency SLOs but reacting to noisy metrics -> oscillation. We'll set a hard pin to eu-west2 for production traffic while we stabilize.

sarah.k: applying emergency pin for prod routes -> `rbctl route set-affinity --route service-prod --region eu-west2 --reason "emergency-stable-pin"`

ops-bot: affinity update queued. Expected convergence ~90s.

nate.l: quick health check: marking eu-west2-a backend instance group as draining for infra team to investigate 503s. `gcloud compute backend-services set-backend --global --instance-group=ig-euw-a --balancing-mode=UTILIZATION --max-utilization=0.01`

emily-r: opening ticket with infra: possible AZ partial network issue. Noted that some hosts in eu-west2-a have higher packet loss on internal probe.

devon.p: adding mitigation: increase spin-up of warm instances in eu-west2-b/c to handle load while eu-west2-a is drained. `autoscale scale --asg production-eu --min 4 --max 20`

sarah.k: customer-impact: intermittent errors and latency for EU customers, estimated 10% of requests affected across the window. I'll draft a short status message for CS.

jamie: agreed. quick comms: "We're seeing routing instability impacting a subset of EU traffic. Mitigation in progress; we'll provide updates every 30m." Keep support looped.

devon.p: telemetry shows rate of 5xx dropping after pin + drain. latency trending back toward baseline. Keeping control plane steering disabled until postmortem.

nate.l: handing off to night oncall @emily-r for monitoring and infra follow-ups — recorded actions: steering policy disabled, prod routes pinned to eu-west2, eu-west2-a drained, autoscale increased, infra ticket #INC-7382 created.

emily-r: acknowledged — I'll watch until handheld handoff at 0400 UTC. will post updates in thread. Planning: confirm infra findings, validate drain completes, and coordinate with cloud provider if packet loss persists.

ops-bot: oncall handoff recorded: from=sarah.k to=emily-r at=4860004234. Incident state: MITIGATED -> monitoring.

sarah.k: small follow-ups: please collect kernel/network counters from eu-west2-a nodes (`/var/log/netstat-summary.log`) and export for postmortem. Also save the rollout config that triggered the oscillation.

devon.p: copied config to /var/artifacts/4860001234/rollout-config.json and uploaded logs bundle: https://internal.artifacts/4860001234/logs.zip

emily-r: will run captures and coordinate with infra during night. If packet loss > 0.5% after 2 hours, we'll open cloud provider ticket for suspected fabric issue.

jamie: thanks team. nice quick work on the pin/disable/drain sequence. We'll schedule a postmortem tomorrow to talk about rollout damping and safer heuristics.

incident-bot: Incident update saved. Closure note: mitigations applied; monitoring continuing. Next update expected within 30m or on significant state change. :white_check_mark:
